**Summary:**

I resolved ticket T-6002 by investigating the incomplete scale-up of the docindex StatefulSet. The issue was that docindex-3 pod was created but remained not-ready due to a configuration mismatch: the pod's CLUSTER_SIZE environment variable was set to 3, causing the new ordinal-3 pod to run as a standby with failing readiness probes (HTTP 503). This stalled the entire scale-up operation since Kubernetes StatefulSets require predecessors to be ready before creating subsequent pods. The fix is to update the CLUSTER_SIZE environment variable in the StatefulSet spec from 3 to 5, allowing all new pods to join the cluster properly.
